scenario.task:
I want to fix my Satellite TV which is showing Error 101 on the screen

User Guide: The user explains they have Satellite TV and see Error 101. They will verify their identity and ask for steps to clear the error If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
